description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Effect You inject yourself or a creature in your reach with medical nanites, which have the effects of both a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.Hypopen (Commercial)] and a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.Medpatch (Commercial)]. The grade of these items increases to tactical (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.Hypopen (Tactical)] and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.Medpatch (Tactical)]) at level 9, advanced (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.Hypopen (Advanced)] and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.Medpatch (Advanced)]) at level 13, and superior (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.Hypopen (Superior)] and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.Medpatch (Superior)]) at level 18.

Special If you have the medic SRO heritage, you can Inject Nanites once per 10 minutes.
